name: versus
description: Rank anything by comparing two items at a time.
author: Steeve Pommier

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.worker:dev: vite build --mode worker && wrangler d1 migrations apply versus-registry --local -c worker/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.worker:bucket: wrangler r2 bucket create versus-images -c worker/wrangler.jsonc || echo 'bucket versus-images already exists'
scripts.worker:deploy: vite build --mode worker && npm run worker:bucket && wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply versus-registry --remote -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
